high_level_description: This image captures a stunning night sky filled with countless stars, creating a mesmerizing celestial display. The central focus is the Milky Way galaxy, which appears as a dense band of stars and cosmic dust stretching vertically across the frame. The galaxy's bright core is more concentrated towards the center, gradually becoming less dense as it extends outward. The background is a deep, dark blue, indicative of the vastness of space. Scattered throughout the sky are numerous stars of varying brightness, adding to the overall beauty and depth of the scene.
